{{Quote|You're supposed to be bunking out. I want you wide awake when it's my turn to snooze.|Mag, to [[Shiv (clone trooper)|Shiv]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />}}
'''Mag''' was a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were stationed at [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. Mag and his squad were assigned to field-test an assortment of subzero gear, including the [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|CK-6 swoop]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|bike]]. However, the squad was beset by many problems, including an elusive and deadly [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that they encountered, which the squad nicknamed the "[[Talz/Legends|ice men]]." The "ice men" killed any [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] patrol they encountered, leaving no witnesses. One [[Standard day/Legends|night]], Mag and a clone trooper under his command, [[Shiv (clone trooper)|Shiv]], were attacked and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the "ice men" while inspecting one of the station's outer [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].

After the death of Mag and Shiv, the remaining clones stationed at Glid Station were killed by the "ice men," along with all the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] at the nearby [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base. The Republic later sent a search party to Orto Plutonia to investigate what had happened to Glid Station. The party discovered that the "ice men" were, in fact, a [[Talz village/Legends|colony]] of Talz that had been attacked by the Separatists. In the resulting conflict, the Republic base was caught in the middle of the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|fighting]] between the two factions.

==Biography==
===Orto Plutonia===
{{Quote|Flanker, eh? Hatchmate, I take it. Where's he at?''"<br />"''Flanker&hellip;he&hellip;he, uh, died on Christophsis, sir.|Mag and Shiv, talking about Shiv's letters|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />}}
Mag<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> was the chosen name of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] and trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to be a<ref name="clone troopers" /> [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|cold assault]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], Mag and his squad were stationed at [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]], a Republic outpost on the [[Water/Legends|frozen]] world of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> The planet was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the sovereign [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], populated by the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]], which had remained allied to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref> While there, Mag and his squad were tasked with testing an assortment of experimental cold weather devices, including the [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|CK-6 swoop]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|bike]], nicknamed the "Freeco bike."<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

While on Orto Plutonia, Mag's squad was met with several difficulties. The squad's [[Ration cube/Legends|rations]] were not shipped in insulated canisters, and due to the extreme cold, the rations were frozen solid. This forced the clones to boil their food, which took away what little flavor the rations had. In addition, the Freeco bikes required perpetual attention for they froze up if not constantly maintained. Compounding matters, Mag's squad continued to encounter a large, mysterious, and deadly [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] they called the "[[Talz/Legends|ice men]]." All the patrols that happened upon the "ice men" were [[Death/Legends|killed]], leaving the true nature of the species unknown.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

Although there was a nearby Separatist base on the planet,<ref name="The Clone Wars: Trespass" /> Mag and his squad never encountered any [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, the clones attempted to stay in fighting shape by building snowmen that resembled [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]&mdash;using them as target practice.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

===Death===
[[File:Magdeath.png|thumb|left|180px|The Talz attack Mag.]]
One night, while Mag and one of his [[Clone trooper/Legends|men]], [[Shiv (clone trooper)|Shiv]], were inspecting an outer [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], their Freeco bikes froze up. This left the two stranded until dawn, when Glid Station could send an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] to pick them up. The two clones built a small camp, set a tent, and prepared to wait out the night. However, while Mag and Shiv were discussing a letter Shiv was writing to a [[hatchmate]] of his, [[Flanker]], the two clones were attacked by the "ice men." The "ice men" ripped open the tent and killed Mag, and next killed Shiv while he was reaching for a [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> Later, both Glid Station and the nearby Confederate outpost were attacked by the "ice men," and all of the clone troopers and battle droids present at both bases were eradicated.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Trespass" />

When the Republic lost contact with Glid Station, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] sent an investigation party, led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to Orto Plutonia to determine the fate of the outpost. The team was accompanied by representatives from Pantora: [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] and Galactic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] investigation discovered that the "ice men" were in fact a peaceful [[Talz village/Legends|tribe]] of Talz that had been attacked by the Separatist battle droids. In the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|resulting conflict]], Mag, Shiv, and the rest of Glid Station had been caught in the middle of the fighting between the two factions.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Trespass" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all clones of Jango Fett, Mag stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="clone troopers" /> Mag was not amused finding Shiv writing letters instead of sleeping and chastised his subordinate for it.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

==Equipment==
On Orto Plutonia, Mag wore [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|cold assault trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|red]] stripes on the helmet and the shoulder pads. He also [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a Freeco bike.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mag made his first and only appearance in the six-page [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Cold Snap|''Cold Snap'']], which led directly into "[[Trespass]],"<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series''.<ref name="Trespass Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode015.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Trespass}}</ref>
